ns2:course.label: IT for Networked Organizations
ns2:course.description: Examines the information technology and its impact on modern organizations. Topics include: (1) IT, Internet Technologies, E-Commerce and business models, (2) organizing and modeling enterprise data, (3) Network protocol and architecture, (4) development of IT systems and (5) IT management and organization design. Prerequisite: CS 105 and at least two of the following: FIN 221, ACCY 201, BADM 310 and BADM 320.
